podcast.title: Accelerated Music Phenomenon
podcast.body: Nightcore is a genre characterized by accelerated music and typically features high-pitched vocals. It gained popularity on platforms like YouTube years ago and, far from dying out, has spread significantly on TikTok. "El Nightcore se popularizó en la plataforma hace años y lejos de morir se está extendiendo en TikTok."

srcs.episode: ¿Por qué el Slowed & Reverb y los Speed Up están rompiendo YT y TikTok?

podcast.title: Microaesthetic of Idealized Medieval Life
podcast.body: Nightcore, alongside other micro-aesthetics like Cottagecore, Goblincore, and Dark Academia, is actively rescuing and promoting an idealized vision of medieval life. This trend acts as a refuge in the current era of screens and uncertainty, offering an escape into a fast-paced, high-pitched electronic aesthetic. "el Nightcore (...) están rescatando una visión idealizada de la vida medieval."

srcs.episode: Por qué todo suena medieval en 2025? (Dungeon Synth, Bardcore...)

podcast.title: Visuals and Evolution to "Speed Up"
podcast.body: Virtually any song searched online can be found in a Nightcore version, often accompanied by images of anime-style drawn girls. Today, the term "Nightcore" is gradually being superseded by the more general "Speed Up" as the preferred label for these new accelerated versions, reflecting a shift in terminology on platforms like TikTok. "Hoy en día el término Nightcore ha ido perdiendo peso frente al término Speed Up y es más habitual encontrar nuevas versiones bajo esa monetilla."

srcs.episode: ¿Por qué el Slowed & Reverb y los Speed Up están rompiendo YT y TikTok?
